newsitem.title: UK: Ashquay says offers UK Estates holders value.
newsitem.headline: Ashquay says offers UK Estates holders value.

text.p: British property company Ashquay Group Plc, which earlier today made an all-share offer for UK Estates PLC said it could offer an immediate reversal of value trend for UK Estates shareholders.

In a statement, Ashquay chief executive Harry Sproule said it was "offering an immediate and substantial increase in value to UK Estates shareholders who have seen their original investment fall by 15 percent over the last two years."

Ashquay, which has only been deeply involved in property since it made an acquisition in January this year, is offering 10 offer shares for every 13 UK Estates ordinary shares, valuing the target company at 21.1 million stg.
During the morning, UK Estates shares have risen by 6p, or 3.75 percent, following news of the bid.
Sproule said his company's management offered UK Estates shareholders "the best chance of enhanced earnings in the future".
UK Estates has said it is considering the offer but has advised its shareholders not to take any action in the meantime.
Ashquay shares slipped by 4p to 41-1/2p during the morning, for a fall of about 8.8 percent.
